name: Sync Valhalla Sigma rules into Sekoia Rules Catalog
description: Periodically pulls the Valhalla Sigma feed and pushes each rule into the Sekoia Rules Catalog so it runs in the detection engine. New rules are created, known rules are updated in place, and a rule the user has disabled in the catalog stays disabled across syncs.

enabled.title: Enable rules on push
enabled.description: If false (default), newly-imported rules are disabled on first import. Existing rules keep their current catalog state.

min_sigma_level.title: Minimum Sigma level
min_sigma_level.description: Only rules with a Sigma `level` at least this severe are imported. Rules missing the `level` field are always skipped.

min_sigma_status.title: Minimum Sigma status
min_sigma_status.description: Only rules with a Sigma `status` at least this mature are imported (ordering: experimental < test < stable). Rules with status `deprecated` or `unsupported` are never imported. Rules missing the `status` field are always skipped.

disable_removed.title: Disable rules removed from the Valhalla feed
disable_removed.description: Disables rules that Nextron removed from the Valhalla feed, or that newly fell below your minimum level/status. The rule stays in the catalog (not deleted); if Nextron re-publishes it later, the sync resumes updating it. Default false runs a dry-run — candidates are counted under `to_disable` on the summary event. Set true to actually disable. The pass is skipped when the feed is empty or shrank by more than 20% (see `disable_skipped_reason`). Enable it on only one trigger per community.

preserve_rule_names.title: Preserve rule names (per-rule opt-out)
preserve_rule_names.description: Rules matching an entry of this list are not overwritten by future syncs — counted under `preserved` on the summary event. An entry matches the rule's name as shown in the Sekoia Rules Catalog, or one of its tags (e.g. `uuid-<valhalla_id>`, which is unique). Match is case-sensitive; surrounding whitespace is tolerated. Leave empty (default) to disable. Any customisation of a synced rule that is not listed here is overwritten on the next sync. The `disable_removed` pass still runs on preserved rules — only the content is protected. Use the Form input mode. To delete entries from this list, create a new trigger configuration.
